metadata.question: Does the nighttime light intensity in Reykjavík show higher values compared to the Snæfellsnes peninsula in 2016?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Dataset: Try VIIRS DNB monthly composites for 2016. Preferred: NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG (stray-light corrected). Fallback to NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMCFG.
- Date: 2016-01-01 to 2016-12-31, compute mean annual radiance.
- Location: Reykjavík (buffered point) vs. Snæfellsnes peninsula (rectangle).

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Monthly composites are already cloud-free products. No additional cloud masking. Optionally report cf_cvg (cloud-free coverage) if available.

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- Check collection size; if 0 for all fallbacks -> C1.
- Count valid pixels after processing; if 0 for either region -> C2.
- If mean is null/NaN/non-finite -> C3.
- Otherwise compare Reykjavík mean > Snæfellsnes mean -> A (Yes), else B (No).
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const start = '2016-01-01';
    const end = '2016-12-31';
    const reykjavik = ee.Geometry.Point([-21.9426, 64.1466]).buffer(15000).bounds();
    const snaefellsnes = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
      [[-24.0, 64.55], [-21.8, 64.55], [-21.8, 65.25], [-24.0, 65.25], [-24.0, 64.55]]
    ]);

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check with fallbacks
    const datasetCandidates = [
      'NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG',
      'NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMCFG',
      'NOAA/NGDC/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG'
    ];
    let usedId = null;
    let col = null;

    for (const ds of datasetCandidates) {
      try {
        const tmp = ee.ImageCollection(ds)
          .filterDate(start, end)
          .select(['avg_rad']); // ensure band exists
        const size = tmp.size().getInfo();
        if (size && size > 0) {
          usedId = ds;
          col = tmp;
          break;
        }
      } catch (e) {
        // try next candidate
      }
    }

    if (!col) {
      console.log('2016 Images: 0');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    const nImgs = col.size().getInfo();
    const annualAvg = col.mean().rename('avg_rad');

    // Optional cloud-free coverage (if available)
    let cfInfo = null;
    try {
      const firstBands = ee.ImageCollection(usedId).first().bandNames().getInfo();
      if (firstBands && firstBands.indexOf('cf_cvg') !== -1) {
        const cfAnnual = ee.ImageCollection(usedId).filterDate(start, end).select('cf_cvg').mean().rename('cf_cvg');
        const cfRvk = cfAnnual.reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
          geometry: reykjavik,
          scale: 1000,
          maxPixels: 1e10
        }).get('cf_cvg').getInfo();
        const cfSna = cfAnnual.reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
          geometry: snaefellsnes,
          scale: 1000,
          maxPixels: 1e10
        }).get('cf_cvg').getInfo();
        if (cfRvk !== null && cfSna !== null) {
          cfInfo = { rvk: cfRvk, sna: cfSna };
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      // ignore optional coverage if not available
    }

    // 3. Processing: pixel counts (detect C2)
    const countRvk = ee.Number(
      annualAvg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: reykjavik,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e10
      }).get('avg_rad')
    ).getInfo();
    const countSna = ee.Number(
      annualAvg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: snaefellsnes,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e10
      }).get('avg_rad')
    ).getInfo();

    if (!countRvk || !countSna || countRvk === 0 || countSna === 0) {
      console.log(`Dataset: ${usedId}, 2016 Images: ${nImgs}`);
      console.log(`Reykjavik Pixels: ${countRvk || 0}`);
      console.log(`Snaefellsnes Pixels: ${countSna || 0}`);
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // 4. Calculation: mean radiance
    const meanRvk = ee.Number(
      annualAvg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry: reykjavik,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e10
      }).get('avg_rad')
    ).getInfo();
    const meanSna = ee.Number(
      annualAvg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry: snaefellsnes,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e10
      }).get('avg_rad')
    ).getInfo();

    // 5. Validation & Final Answer
    const valid = (v) => v !== null && isFinite(v);
    if (!valid(meanRvk) || !valid(meanSna)) {
      console.log(`Dataset: ${usedId}, 2016 Images: ${nImgs}`);
      console.log(`Means -> Reykjavik: ${meanRvk}, Snaefellsnes: ${meanSna}`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    console.log(`Dataset: ${usedId}, 2016 Images: ${nImgs}`);
    if (cfInfo) {
      console.log(`CF_Coverage% -> Reykjavik: ${cfInfo.rvk.toFixed(1)}, Snaefellsnes: ${cfInfo.sna.toFixed(1)}`);
    }
    console.log(`Reykjavik mean(rad): ${meanRvk.toFixed(3)}, pixels: ${countRvk}`);
    console.log(`Snaefellsnes mean(rad): ${meanSna.toFixed(3)}, pixels: ${countSna}`);

    if (meanRvk > meanSna) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
